stops.stop: Cologne, the letter of Johann Reuchlin
stops.date_confidence: attested. ADB directly confirms Reuchlin's letter of 1 November 1518 to Cardinal Achille de Grassis attributing Peter's death to Hoogstraten's persecution; the research pool hedged this as a legend only loosely supported, and the hedge is corrected. The Latin phrase 'prae maerore' was not located in any primary text and is not quoted here [R for the wording]. The letter concerns the Cologne expulsion, so the stop sits at Peter's Cologne pin; Reuchlin's own writing of it belongs on Reuchlin's file, not this one.
